text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the end of the school day, and I'm
taking a
walk to reset my mood when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All right! Lights and sound are both
good. All
that's left is to check the
stands...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello! And yeah! My class is having a
concert
rehearsal here tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm just having a look around to make
sure
everything will run smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Thank you! This is technically part
of the
class representative's
responsibilities.
choice_data_list: I see, that's a wonderful mindset.
I see, that's an admirable mindset.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So, really, this isn't anything specia—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Did you feel that? Is it about to
rain?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Let's take shelter inside.
Come on,
hurry!
choice_data_list: How about taking a break for now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Looks like both of us managed to
stay dry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's just a passing shower, so
it should
let up soon. Thank goodness
for that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. I can use this time to change
the water in
the classroom's flower vase.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I think we may need more chalk too...
Oh, and I can't
forget to clean the
chalkboard erasers!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I am taking a break. I find it refreshing to do simple tasks.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need a break?
Are you okay without a break?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, excuse me! I'm going to get
working
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I walk past the stage and
see the
rehearsal taking place as
planned.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll wrap things up before it really
starts
pouring!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You should head inside so you don't get
wet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Top Road has already
rocketed
off through the stands to give
each seat a quick
visual inspection.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I found a can! Someone must have
forgotten
to recycle it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She efficiently checks the stands and
promptly
heads back into the school
building after she's
done.
choice_data_list: (Didn't even need my help after all.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I walk past the stage and
see the
rehearsal taking place as
planned.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was the spike tape always this
easy to see?
The stage floor looks so
clean too...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! The mic is working better than
before too!
I wonder if it was Class Rep
who did all this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! It's time to begin our
rehearsal, so
let's wrap up our
conversations and get into a
line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The students respond to her cheerily
and quickly
fall in line. It's fantastic how
committed Narita
Top Road is to
supporting her peers!
